vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
使目标的被动技能暂时失效
跟着单位持续影响周围单位；对友军或敌方都算，并记作用对象；固定在地上的区域归场地魔法
说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
技能或物品用一次消耗一点；只决定数值或层数的不算
技能能缩短技能或物品的冷却；A杖或魔晶只降低技能自身冷却的不记，从字段读
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
提供额外金钱或经验；只是正常赏金不算
自身有概率使敌方攻击落空
飞行移动，能越过地形
嘲讽、恐惧、催眠等强制目标攻击或移动；夺取控制权不在此类（归召唤物）
提供目标或区域的视野
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
攻击或技能恢复自身生命：按造成的伤害、按目标生命或每次攻击固定值（攻击吸血、技能吸血、如噬魂鬼·盛宴、附魂面具）
降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法或技能伤害
阻止目标闪烁、传送或离开范围；只是不能走的归定身
主动使已飞来的弹道落空；“无法被躲避”的说明不算
死亡后复活，或影响复活
使隐身单位显形，不等于持续真视
闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
降低移动速度或攻击速度
提高技能造成的伤害
使指向自身或队友的技能失效
把指向技能反弹给施法者
缩短自身受到的控制与减益的持续时间（如散夜对剑+16%）
使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
召唤有血量的单位（可控或不可控都算），以及夺取已有单位的控制权；按受攻击次数计算的单位和死亡守卫不算

objects.subject: queenofpain_succubus
objects.description_zh: 所有来源的技能吸血也对纯粹伤害生效。痛苦女王获得技能吸血，与敌人的距离越近效果越强。敌人距离她不到%close_radius%距离时达到最强效果，距离她超过%max_radius%距离时为最弱效果。
objects.description_en: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is %close_radius% units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is %max_radius% units or further from her.

objects.subject: queenofpain_sonic_wave
objects.description_zh: 痛苦女王在她面前制造出强大的声波，对其轨迹上的所有敌人造成大量伤害，并将他们击退。
objects.description_en: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.
notes_zh: 超声冲击波最远能伤害1150距离外的单位。

objects.subject: venomancer_venomous_gale
objects.description_zh: 沿直线射出一个毒液球，碰到的敌人受到初始伤害和持续伤害，并受到减速效果影响。瘴气在持续时间内每3秒造成一次持续伤害。
objects.description_en: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement.  Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.
notes_zh: 瘴气可以致死。
技能持续时间内每%tick_interval%秒造成一次伤害。
初始减速效果为%movement_slow%%%，减速效果将逐渐降低。

shard.zh: 施法距离和弹道速度提升%shard_travel_tooltip%%%。瘴气只要击中每个敌方英雄就会在他们周围制造%num_created_wards_tooltip%个瘟疫守卫。
shard.en: Increases cast range and projectile speed by %shard_travel_tooltip%%%. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, %num_created_wards_tooltip% Plague Wards are created around them.

objects.subject: venomancer_snakebite
objects.description_zh: 剧毒术士召唤阿克特克的幼体，把它的毒牙刺入一个敌人，造成魔法伤害，并施加造成每秒伤害的剧毒。目标在感染时发动攻击，他就会再次受到初始伤害。
objects.description_en: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.

objects.subject: venomancer_plague_ward
objects.description_zh: 召唤一个瘟疫守卫来攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫对魔法免疫。守卫拥有毒刺攻击，效果与毒刺技能的当前等级相同，造成50%的原技能伤害。
objects.description_en: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.

objects.subject: venomancer_poison_sting
objects.description_zh: 剧毒的攻击会持续减速敌人并造成伤害。
objects.description_en: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.
notes_zh: 毒刺的伤害可以致死。
毒刺造成的持续性伤害不会打断物品的回复效果，也不能使闪烁匕首进行冷却状态。

objects.subject: venomancer_noxious_plague
objects.description_zh: 使一名敌人感染致命的瘟疫，施加时造成伤害，然后减速目标，并且基于目标的最大生命值造成持续伤害。不论负面状态以何种方式消失，瘟疫都会带着剧毒术士施加给初始目标的所有负面状态一起扩散到附近目标。第一次以外的额外扩散不会造成初始伤害。
objects.description_en: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
notes_zh: 扩散的负面状态拥有固定的持续时间，不会受到状态抗性和负面状态增强的影响。

scepter.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染的单位拥有的魔法抗性会降低。来自英雄目标的额外扩散会造成全额的击中伤害。
scepter.en: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown% seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.

objects.subject: faceless_void_time_walk
objects.description_zh: 冲到目标位置，并取消最近%backtrack_duration%秒内受到的任何伤害。
objects.description_en: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last %backtrack_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 虚空假面在时间漫游过程中为无敌状态。

scepter.zh: 在落地点对所有单位施加一次时间锁定。
scepter.en: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.

objects.subject: faceless_void_time_dilation
objects.description_zh: 虚空假面将附近所有敌人困在一个时间膨胀场中，技能的冷却都会减慢。施加时每个受困的敌人都会获得一层时间膨胀的叠加效果，每有一个技能处于冷却就再获得一层。每层叠加效果造成每秒伤害，并降低移动速度和攻击速度降低。持续时间在时间结界作用下会暂停。
objects.description_en: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.
notes_zh: 不会影响物品的冷却时间。
效果期间叠加层数还会改变。施放技能后如果技能进入冷却就会提供一层叠加效果。如果技能冷却在时间膨胀期间完成，效果会被移除。

shard.zh: 提升每层叠加的减速。向虚空假面提供叠加效果，可以提升他的攻击和移动速度。叠加层数等于施放时施加给敌人的时间膨胀叠加层数的总和，效果会在持续时间内线性衰减。
shard.en: Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.

objects.subject: faceless_void_distortion_field
objects.description_zh: 虚空假面附近%friendly_hero_distance%范围内以他或友方英雄为目标的敌方攻击弹道在进入目标%slow_distance_max%范围后会被减速%attack_projectile_slow%%%。
objects.description_en: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a %friendly_hero_distance% radius of him get slowed by %attack_projectile_slow%%%, when they get  within %slow_distance_max% distance of their target.

objects.subject: faceless_void_chronosphere
objects.description_zh: 在时空中创造一个泡状遮罩，将所有位于其中的单位定住，并使虚空假面在其内部来去自如。只有虚空假面和他控制的单位不受影响。在其中的隐形敌人会显形。
objects.description_en: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.
notes_zh: 能够定住所有单位和建筑，不论敌我。除了虚空假面控制的单位。
虚空假面不受任何时间结界的影响。

objects.subject: skeleton_king_hellfire_blast
objects.description_zh: 冥魂大帝向一个敌方单位发射冥魂火球，造成即时伤害和眩晕，并持续对目标造成伤害和减速。
objects.description_en: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.

objects.subject: skeleton_king_bone_guard
objects.description_zh: 击杀2个非英雄单位可获得1点能量，击杀1名英雄可获得2点能量。可以主动使用，消耗所有能量点数召唤可以复活一次的骷髅兵。骷髅兵享受吸血灵魂的吸血效果。
objects.description_en: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
对敌人施放冥火爆击会导致骷髅兵攻击该敌人。

objects.subject: skeleton_king_mortal_strike
objects.description_zh: 冥魂大帝被动地在攻击时造成额外伤害，本技能具有冷却时间。
objects.description_en: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.

shard.zh: 本命一击会诅咒目标，使其在%curse_delay%秒延迟后再次受到%curse_damage_pct%%%原攻击伤害的纯粹伤害。吸血灵魂的吸血效果对诅咒伤害有效。
shard.en: Mortal Strike hits curse their target, causing them to take %curse_damage_pct%%% of the initial attack damage again as Pure damage after a %curse_delay% second delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage.

objects.subject: skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit
objects.description_zh: 冥魂大帝获得吸血效果。被击杀时冥魂大帝变为移动无视地形的冥魂，拥有额外攻击和移动速度，持续较短时间，自身死亡延后。冥魂大帝变为冥魂后无法重生。
objects.description_en: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.
notes_zh: 对于死亡被延缓的友军，其成为冥魂前所受的最后一击来源即为击杀者。
触发绝冥再生时没有效果。
破坏只会使被动吸血失效。
复活时间会根据冥魂持续时间而减少。

scepter.zh: 吸血灵魂变为光环，使友方英雄被击杀时也能变为冥魂。延长冥魂的持续时间。
scepter.en: Turns Vampiric Spirit into an aura, allowing allied heroes to turn into wraiths when slain. Extends wraith duration.

objects.subject: skeleton_king_reincarnation
objects.description_zh: 冥魂大帝倒下后，他飞散的冥魂会重组，使他复活。死亡时附近%slow_radius%范围内的敌人会被减速，会产生骷髅兵攻击附近每个敌方英雄。可以对自身施放，使冥魂大帝立刻阵亡。
objects.description_en: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.  Upon death, enemy units in a %slow_radius% radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
notes_zh: 如果魔法不足冥魂大帝将不会重生。
如果冥魂大帝拥有不朽之守护，同时绝冥再生不处于冷却状态，死亡后将首先触发绝冥再生。
重生后生命值和魔法值全满。

objects.subject: death_prophet_carrion_swarm
objects.description_zh: 召唤一群食腐虫在死亡先知面前的敌人中肆虐。
objects.description_en: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
notes_zh: 最远能伤害1110距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

objects.subject: death_prophet_spirit_siphon
objects.description_zh: 创造一个灵魂连接，将死亡先知与一个敌方单位相连。每秒吸取生命值。
objects.description_en: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
notes_zh: 多个连接不能同时作用于一个目标。

shard.zh: 吸魂巫术的能量点数提升%shard_bonus_charges%点，敌人连续%shard_consecutive_siphon_duration%秒受到吸魂巫术作用后会被恐惧%shard_fear_duration%秒。
shard.en: Increases Spirit Siphon charges by %shard_bonus_charges% and causes enemies to be feared for %shard_fear_duration% seconds if they are siphoned for %shard_consecutive_siphon_duration% seconds consecutively.

objects.subject: death_prophet_witchcraft
objects.description_zh: 死亡先知的神秘学识随着经验积累而加深，获得移动速度和技能冷却时间减少。
objects.description_en: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.

objects.subject: death_prophet_exorcism
objects.description_zh: 释放恶灵偷走敌方单位和建筑的生命。恶灵需要回到她身上才能再次攻击。持续时间结束后，死亡先知根据造成的伤害量，获得一定比例的治疗。对建筑造成50%%伤害。持续%abilityduration%秒。
objects.description_en: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
notes_zh: 作用范围代表死亡先知周围的恶灵寻找目标的范围。
伤害格挡类技能不能减少恶灵伤害。

scepter.zh: 敌人受到死亡先知的技能作用，或被死亡先知攻击时，会有一只恶灵飞出攻击敌人，造成高于平常的伤害，再返回使自身回复生命。
scepter.en: Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.

objects.subject: phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger
objects.description_zh: 对敌方单位掷出一把匕首，减缓其移动速度，并造成物理伤害，数值为%base_damage%+幻影刺客攻击伤害的%attack_factor_tooltip%%%，同时继承物品和技能的攻击效果。
objects.description_en: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing %base_damage%+%attack_factor_tooltip%%% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
notes_zh: 如果攻击效果为几率触发，匕首的触发几率与原几率相同。
减益免疫下的敌人不会受到窒碍短匕的减速影响。
窒碍短匕在行进途中和击中目标时都会提供附近的视野。

objects.subject: phantom_assassin_phantom_strike
objects.description_zh: 传送到一个单位身旁，敌我皆可，如果目标是敌方单位将进行攻击并获得攻速加成。
objects.description_en: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.

objects.subject: phantom_assassin_blur
objects.description_zh: 幻影刺客模糊自己的身形，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，提升她的移动速度，使她无法被看到，直到她靠近敌方英雄或防御塔。
objects.description_en: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
notes_zh: 通过普通攻击攻击肉山会驱散魅影无形。

shard.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。只要幻影刺客击杀英雄，她的技能冷却时间都会加快%cooldown_refund_pct%%%最高冷却时间。
shard.en: Decreases Cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance %cooldown_refund_pct%%% of their max cooldown values.

objects.subject: phantom_assassin_fan_of_knives
objects.description_zh: 幻影刺客对附近范围内敌人放出尖利的刀刃，击中时造成每名受害者最大生命值一定百分比的伤害并施加破坏效果。
objects.description_en: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.

objects.subject: phantom_assassin_immaterial
objects.description_zh:
幻影刺客专注一心，闪避敌人攻击的技艺得到提升。

与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。
objects.description_en:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks.

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.
